title: Monthly benchmark prices for observatory commodities
source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet)
license: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0; source-specific exceptions may apply)
note: Nominal US dollar benchmarks. They are not bilateral Africa–Asia contract prices. Tea is the Mombasa auction series. Tobacco is the US import unit value; a missing month is not a zero price. Sugar is the ISA world price, not the EU or US series. Phosphate rock is f.o.b. North Africa, not DAP, TSP, or urea. Copper is the LME grade A cathode settlement, not copper ore or concentrate.

series.detail: International Cocoa Organization price, nominal US dollars per kilogram.
Mombasa auction. This is the Kenya tea benchmark in the Pink Sheet.
World Bank Pink Sheet palm oil series.
World Bank Pink Sheet orange series.
SGX/SICOM TSR20 nearby futures, nominal US dollars per kilogram. This is the grade West African exporters typically ship. Not a bilateral contract price.
World Bank Pink Sheet groundnuts series. Not groundnut oil and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price.
US No. 2 yellow maize, f.o.b. US Gulf ports. Not sorghum, not FAO production, and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price.
US import unit value. Not a Zimbabwe auction price, not FAO production, and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price. A missing month is not a zero price.
International Sugar Agreement world price, nominal US dollars per kilogram. Not the EU or US sugar price, not FAO cane, beet, or raw-sugar production, and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price.
Phosphate rock, f.o.b. North Africa. Not DAP, TSP, or urea, not HS 31 manufactured fertilizer, and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price.
LME grade A copper cathode settlement, nominal US dollars per metric ton. Not copper ore or concentrate, not HS 2603, and not a bilateral Africa–Asia contract price.
